question: Does Taiwan possess direct individual-investor stock/order data, and if so is there an authorized public/replayable source contract suitable for D06-19 L3?

evidence: TWSE Fact Book annual trading value by investor/shareholder structure
TWSE Fact Book domestic individual ownership by size
sourceClasses.semantics: direct natural-person identity at market/segment/ownership level

evidence: TWSE Data E-Shop foreign professional/investor-category trading amount product
sourceClasses.semantics: foreign natural-person aggregate trading values, not domestic natural-person stock-level directional flow
an investor can retrieve their own account, transaction and order records

evidence: Chen et al. 2026 Journal of Banking & Finance acquired a unique TWSE limit-order-book dataset directly from TWSE for 2013-05-02 through 2018-03-31
dataset fields include stock identifier, buy/sell order direction, price/volume and investor type including individual investor, foreign investor, others and securities investment trust
earlier Taiwan studies also report complete trade-by-trade records of TWSE traders for historical research periods
sourceClasses.semantics: direct stock/order-level investor-type data demonstrably exist inside TWSE/research-access channels

keyConclusion.oldAmbiguity: NO_PUBLIC_SOURCE_FOUND could be misread as DATA_DOES_NOT_EXIST
keyConclusion.reason: No currently authorized/reproducible source contract for this project has been verified, including application eligibility, current coverage, production/publication clock, firstKnownAt semantics, revision/finality, TPEx parity, persistence rights and replay terms.

pitRequirementsBeforeL3: current authorized access path or research agreement class
TPEx parity or explicit TWSE-only scope
falsification: Existence of a historical academic dataset does not imply current public availability.
Access to one's own account history is not a market-wide research feed.
Foreign-natural-person aggregate data cannot substitute domestic natural-person stock flow.
Market-level retail share cannot be backfilled into stock-level directional flow.
A restricted dataset may support research feasibility only after its current access and PIT contract are independently verified.
exactNext: Identify the present TWSE research-data application/licensing route for investor-type stock/order data, including eligibility, cost/licence, allowed persistence, date coverage and delivery clock. Do not purchase or request restricted data autonomously. L3 remains closed until an authorized PIT/replay contract is verified.
